description:
Five9 is a leader in AI-powered cloud contact center software, serving thousands of customers around the world and powering billions of customer interactions every year. We help enterprises deliver smarter customer experience with every interaction, turning every customer conversation into an opportunity to build trust, deepen loyalty, and drive growth. Our Genius CX platform combines deep contact center expertise with applied AI to deliver outcomes the business can measure.

Our team-first culture enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.

This is a contract position.

The Graphic Designer supports the Brand and Creative team across digital and print deliverables and brings a genuine curiosity about how AI tools are changing the way creative work gets done. This role is for someone who isn’t just keeping up with the AI wave, but actively experimenting with it. We move fast, deadlines are real, and priorities shift. The ideal candidate thrives in that environment, not just tolerates it. Curious, tenacious and cross-functional by nature, this person is eager to grow their craft alongside the tools shaping the future of design.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design visually compelling assets across web, social media, presentations, print materials, and event collateral (including booth and kiosk design)
  • Use AI tools including image generation, video prompting and AI-assisted ideation as a regular part of your creative workflow
  • Collaborate with content, marketing and cross-functional teams to develop campaign visuals that align with strategic goals and reinforce brand identity
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality work on tight deadlines
  • Ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints and uphold visual standards throughout every project
  • Prepare print-ready files and coordinate with the Creative Director for review

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field
  • 2 to 4 years of experience designing digital and print marketing assets
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, and Microsoft Office
  • Hands-on experience with AI creative tools such as Claude for ideation and writing, image/video generation models (e.g. Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Runway, etc) and AI workflow platforms like Magnific Spaces
  • Comfortable prompting, iterating, and directing AI tools to produce on-brand output
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (we use Monday.com); Slack and Asana
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines
  • Open to feedback and able to implement revisions quickly without losing momentum
  • Clear communicator who takes direction well and applies feedback effectively
  • A self-starter who takes initiative, thinks creatively and figures things out — whether that means digging into a tutorial, searching the web, or just experimenting until it works
  • Portfolio that showcases creative versatility, strong execution and ideally some AI-assisted work

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in a design agency environment
  • Motion or animated graphics skills for social media
  • Experience with photography prompting or video generation models (e.g., Nano Banana Pro, Runway, Kling)
  • An experimental mindset. You’ve broken tools, learned from it and kept going.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.  

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.
